description: Press the left mouse button at (start_x, start_y), move to (end_x, end_y) and release. Coordinates are pixels of the latest observe_app screenshot (origin top-left); there is no element form. For sliders, moving items (files too), resizing, drawing. File drags that need the real mouse briefly bring the app forward and use it while the user is idle (put back afterwards). Requires a prior observe_app for this app in this session. Call observe_app afterwards to verify the result.

app.description: Target app: its name as listed by find_apps, its id (bundle id / executable name), or its absolute path.

end_x.description: End X in pixels of the latest observe_app screenshot (origin top-left), exactly as seen in the image; the helper converts them to screen points (also for downscaled screenshots).

end_y.description: End Y in pixels of the latest observe_app screenshot (origin top-left), exactly as seen in the image; the helper converts them to screen points (also for downscaled screenshots).

start_x.description: Start X in pixels of the latest observe_app screenshot (origin top-left), exactly as seen in the image; the helper converts them to screen points (also for downscaled screenshots).

start_y.description: Start Y in pixels of the latest observe_app screenshot (origin top-left), exactly as seen in the image; the helper converts them to screen points (also for downscaled screenshots).
